synthesis.executive_summary: 今日论文情报聚焦于OCR/文档解析的多个前沿方向：一是历史手稿的高效标注自动化，二是多模态RAG在图纸理解和合规检查中的应用，三是多模态知识图谱中的上下文增强，四是LLM智能体工作流中的约束弱化问题。这些工作共同表明，文档解析正从纯文本抽取向视觉优先、多模态融合和智能体工作流发展，同时强调效率、可解释性和安全约束的重要性。
synthesis.trend_summary: OCR和文档解析领域正经历从传统文本提取向多模态智能体化、知识图谱化和可解释性方向的转变。关键技术包括多模态大模型、视觉优先的RAG、上下文增强的知识图谱，以及对工作流安全性的关注。
common_innovations: 多模态大模型被广泛应用于文档内容的理解和结构化，如RefLAM和PlanSightRAG。
RAG框架从纯文本向视觉优先和多模态知识图谱融合方向发展。
强调可解释性，通过置信度得分和热力图等机制提供证据跟踪。
面向特定领域（如历史手稿、土木图纸）的定制化OCR管线开发。
对LLM智能体工作流的安全性和约束保持提出新要求。
future_directions: 开发跨语言和脚本的历史手稿标注管线，减少对干净参考文本的依赖，并探索弱监督或无参考场景下的对齐方法。
在真实世界图纸和文档上验证视觉优先RAG的鲁棒性，结合OCR与视觉信息以处理密集文本区域。
将上下文增强的多模态知识图谱扩展至更多模态（如音频、视频），并优化上下文选择机制，减小图谱构建成本。
研究动态工作流中操作状态自动保存的方法，结合形式化验证提供更强约束保证。
整合文档解析与领域特定智能体，实现从解析到合规检查或问答的端到端自动化。
engineering_takeaways: RefLAM的级联流程和置信度规则可大幅提升标注效率，适合大规模历史文档语料构建。
PlanSightRAG的视觉优先索引可避免OCR噪声，但需注意真实场景中阈值设定的局限性。
在多模态知识图谱构建阶段注入上下文可显著改善下游RAG性能，但需权衡存储成本。
约束弱化问题警示：在LLM工作流中必须显式保存操作状态，以确保安全机制有效。

papers.title: RefLAM: A Reference-Grounded Line Annotation Pipeline for Historical Arabic Manuscripts
papers.summary: Existing approaches to building line-level Arabic handwritten-text-recognition (HTR) training data either rely on fully manual annotation, which does not scale, or on automatic OCR-to-reference alignment methods not yet extended to multi-script, two-zone (main-plus-margin) manuscript layouts with a provable correctness guarantee. We present RefLAM (Reference-grounded Line Annotation for Manuscripts), a pipeline converting manuscript page images and clean transcriptions into validated, line-level ground truth without sacrificing human oversight. RefLAM couples a deep-learning page-segmentation model with a multimodal large language model (MLLM) for structured OCR and a diacritic-agnostic fuzzy alignment engine that grounds each OCR line in a contiguous span of the reference text, with a character-level confidence score in $[0,100]$. A perfect score is provably equivalent to character-for-character identity of the normalised strings (the Confidence-100 rule), verified with no counterexample across the released corpus. A reviewer can thus trust a perfect score, confirming most lines at a glance rather than retyping them, so annotation becomes triaged, with attention concentrated on uncertain alignments. Across 7 fully page-validated books we measured a 75$\times$ throughput gain over manual annotation (3,000 vs. 40 lines/hr); applying the same guarantee to 7 further books, we retained 16,533 confidence-100 main-text lines within one week, excluding sub-100 lines rather than manually correcting them. Using RefLAM, we release AraMS-28k: 14 historical Arabic manuscript books, 3,043 pages, and 27,971 main-text and 629 margin-line annotations with bounding boxes, layout labels, and insertion anchors for 191 margin entries (30.4%). We also finetune Muharaf-pretrained baselines (including HATFormer) on AraMS-28k and report CER results confirming its practical utility for downstream HTR training.
papers.zh_summary: 提出RefLAM管线，用于历史阿拉伯语手稿的线级标注，结合深度学习页面分割、多模态大模型和模糊对齐引擎，提供可证明的置信度得分，实现人工审核下的高效标注，吞吐量提升75倍，并发布AraMS-28k数据集。
papers.novelty: 首次将参考文本对齐的可证明正确性保证应用于多脚本、双区域手稿布局的线级标注，通过置信度100规则实现人工审核的高效分流。
innovation_points: 提出置信度100规则，证明完美得分与归一化字符串逐字符一致等价，并经语料验证无反例。
结合页面分割模型、多模态大语言模型和模糊对齐引擎的级联流程，实现结构化OCR与参考文本的精确对齐。
开发三分类审核流程，将人工注意力集中在低置信度行上，大幅提升标注效率。
papers.limitations: ['仅针对阿拉伯语手稿，可能不适用于其他语言或现代文档。', '依赖干净转录稿作为参考，对于无参考文本的场景不适用。', '处理双区域布局（主文本加边注）可能限制其通用性。']
improvement_directions: 扩展至更多语言和脚本，评估对齐算法的跨语言泛化能力。
探索无参考或弱参考场景下的标注方法，减少对清洁转录的依赖。
优化低置信度行的半自动校正策略，进一步减少人工干预。
papers.engineering_value: 为手稿数字化提供高效准确的标注工具，显著降低人力成本，适用于大规模历史文档的语料构建。
papers.why_relevant: 针对手写文本识别训练数据的生产瓶颈，提供可扩展的自动化标注方案，对OCR领域的数据建设有直接借鉴意义。

papers.title: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
papers.summary: Civil infrastructure compliance checking has long relied on engineers manually reading legacy 2D plans; however, OCR-based automation strips away the geometry and layout essential for interpreting these plans. We present a Visual-First Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework called PlanSightRAG. It indexes and reasons directly over plan imagery, integrates a ColNomic-3B multi-vector retrieval, an agentic Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer, and MaxSim heatmaps as an evidence trail. We introduce a 4,056-pair benchmark from five state Departments of Transportation (DOT) standard plans (1,898 pages). PlanSightRAG achieves 91.47% Recall@5 on zero-shot retrieval, while on a held-out Michigan DOT corpus, it achieves 91.40%. On synthetic, parametrically-generated compliance drawings, our Qwen2.5-VL-72B pipeline reaches 100% verdict accuracy only when supplied a pre-resolved rule threshold, a controlled ceiling that a non-VLM OCR baseline already reaches at 76.4%. Finally, we demonstrate autonomous visual rule-grounding by extracting numeric limits directly from a specification corpus without any human-supplied rules.
papers.zh_summary: 提出视觉优先的多模态RAG框架PlanSightRAG，直接对图纸图像进行索引和推理，整合多向量检索、智能体流程和热力图证据追踪，用于土木标准图纸的问答和合规检查，在基准上达到91.47%的召回率。
papers.novelty: 放弃传统的OCR文本提取，直接利用视觉信息进行图纸理解，并通过无人类规则的自主视觉规则提取实现合规检查。
innovation_points: 视觉优先的RAG架构，直接索引和推理图像，保留几何与布局信息。
集成ColNomic-3B多向量检索与Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer智能体流程。
引入MaxSim热力图作为证据轨迹，增强可解释性。
构建4,056对基准测试集，来自五个州交通部标准图纸。
papers.limitations: ['依赖合成图纸进行合规验证，真实图纸场景尚需测试。', '在规则阈值预先解析时才能达到100%准确率，实际应用受限。', '未与基于OCR的完整基线进行全面对比。']
improvement_directions: 在更多真实世界图纸上评估，增强泛化性。
探索自动规则解析的鲁棒性，减少人工设定阈值的依赖。
融合OCR与视觉信息，提升对文本密集区域的解释能力。
papers.engineering_value: 可用于土木工程图纸的自动审查和问答，减少人工阅读工作量，提高合规检查效率。
papers.why_relevant: 展示非OCR方案在处理复杂文档时的优势，为OCR在工程图纸领域的应用提供新思路。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Context-Enhanced RAG over Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely used to mitigate hallucination issues in large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). In particular, knowledge graph (KG)-based RAG leverages structured knowledge to provide (M)LLMs with high-quality external information. Building on these works, recent studies have explored multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) as knowledge bases for GraphRAG. This enables Graph RAG to integrate knowledge across multiple modalities, thereby further enhancing its performance. However, existing MMKG-based RAG methods generally follow a common pipeline in which different modalities are largely processed independently before being fusion. As a result, textual context is only used to a limited extent during visual information extraction and subsequent multimodal knowledge fusion. This brings a semantic gap between images and text which limits the multimodal GraphRAG performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework for constructing a Context-Enhanced MMKG (CEMMKG) to better support multimodal GraphRAG. The proposed CEMMKG enriches each image with complementary textual context at both local and global scopes. Local context goes beyond the surrounding text by incorporating sentences that are semantically related to the image, while global context provides a summary of the entire passage. We further introduce a multi-granularity design for the local context, allowing it to capture semantically relevant information at different levels of detail. Extensive experiments on the selected vision-centric dataset validate that CEMMKG is effective in leveraging contextual information to improve MMKG-based RAG performance. Moreover, its effectiveness across different MMKG-based RAG methods demonstrates its broad applicability.
papers.zh_summary: 提出CEMMKG框架，通过为多模态知识图谱中的图像补充局部和全局文本上下文，增强多粒度信息，以改进基于知识图谱的RAG性能，在视觉中心数据集上进行实验验证。
papers.novelty: 针对现有MMKG-RAG方法中多模态融合不足、文本上下文利用有限的问题，提出在构建知识图谱时即注入上下文信息。
innovation_points: 构建上下文增强的MMKG，为每个图像补充语义相关的句子和篇章摘要。
引入多粒度局部上下文设计，捕捉不同细节级别的语义信息。
采用双阶段上下文注入（图谱构建阶段）而非融合阶段，从源头减小语义鸿沟。
papers.limitations: ['实验仅基于视觉中心数据集，可能未覆盖其他领域。', '上下文增强可能增加知识图谱的大小和构建成本。', '对文本与图像间复杂语义关系的建模尚浅。']
improvement_directions: 扩展到更多模态（如音频、视频），探索多模态协同增强。
设计更高效的上下文选择机制，降低噪声影响。
与最新的MLLM结合，动态调整上下文表示。
papers.engineering_value: 为多模态知识图谱的构建和RAG系统提供改进方法，可提升问答等任务的准确性。
papers.why_relevant: 多模态知识图谱是文档理解的重要方向，其改进直接关系到OCR后端的语义推理能力。

papers.title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate complex tasks through multi-role and multi-stage workflows. Upstream state is repeatedly transformed into intermediate language artifacts, such as summaries, plans, tickets, memories, and handoff notes, from which downstream components act. For action-constraining state, topical retention is insufficient: an artifact may mention an unresolved condition while changing it from a requirement that must be resolved before execution into information that may merely inform the next action. We study this action-binding role as operational state preservation. Safety blockers provide a controlled instance because each source state has an explicit prerequisite, authority, fallback, and execution consequence. We condition on correct upstream identification, vary the handoff transformation, and evaluate an executor restricted to the resulting artifact. Across 1,296 controlled synthetic episodes, direct-handoff controls preserve every blocker, whereas compression, plan assimilation, convergence, ownership deferral, and precedent substitution repeatedly turn binding state into caveats or non-binding considerations. Normal handoff compression produces 100.0% deactivation and 54.2% forbidden action. Restoring all four state fields raises preservation to 100.0% and reduces forbidden action to 0.0%. Fixed-artifact interventions further separate preservation from containment: downstream verification eliminates forbidden action while artifact deactivation remains 95.3%. These results identify a state-transmission failure between information extraction and action. Handoff transformations can retain state content while weakening its constraints on downstream action. Semantic availability does not guarantee operational preservation.
papers.zh_summary: 研究LLM智能体工作流中约束弱化问题，通过1,296个受控合成情节，发现压缩、计划合并等转换会丢失操作状态，导致安全阻断器失效，而恢复状态字段可保持100%的保全率。
papers.novelty: 引入“操作状态保存”概念，系统性地分析中间语言工件中的约束传递问题，并量化不同干预措施的影响。
innovation_points: 提出操作状态保存作为约束作用角色的新视角。
设计基准测试，包含安全阻断器实例，精确控制上游识别和下游执行。
识别出多个导致约束弱化的转换类型（压缩、计划合并等），并验证恢复四个状态字段的效果。
papers.limitations: ['仅使用合成情节，未在真实任务中验证。', '关注状态传递，未深入探讨约束内容本身的语义变化。', '固定工件干预可能不适用于动态生成的场景。']
improvement_directions: 在真实多角色工作流中验证，分析影响因素。
研究如何动态确保状态完整保存，避免固定模板依赖。
结合形式化验证方法，提供更强的保证。
papers.engineering_value: 为LLM智能体工作流的设计提供关键指导，确保约束条件在下游执行中得到遵守，提升系统安全性。
papers.why_relevant: LLM智能体涉及信息提取和处理，其约束传递问题对OCR输出在后续任务中的可靠使用具有借鉴意义。
